name: Ewer with a Lion-shaped Spout
material: green-glazed porcelaneous stoneware with modeled, carved and incised decoration, Yaozhou ware
summary: This remarkable ewer is most likely a very early and rare type of Yaozhou ware, with the shape and decoration recalling Tang metal ware.
